svg.title: Five hundred agents taught separately, against one signed lesson inherited by all
svg.desc: Two fields of five hundred dots each, one dot per AI agent. On the left, without a shared gate, every dot is lit separately: each agent is taught the same lesson on its own, five hundred lessons bought for one lesson learned, with no record of who decided what. On the right, with doublegate, a single bright agent writes the lesson, a reviewer that did not write it grades and signs it, and every remaining agent inherits it already approved with the signature travelling with it: one lesson, signed. The same five hundred agents and the same correction in both halves; the difference is whether the company keeps it.
svg.text: Every correction lands in one agent and stops.
The next engineer hits the same wrong assumption
and pays to correct it again. Nobody can say
who decided what, or on what basis.
One writes it. A reviewer that did not write it
grades and signs it. The other 499 inherit it
already approved, and the signature travels
with it — who trusted it, when, on what basis.
Same five hundred agents. Same correction. The difference is whether the company keeps it.
